title: Biomehaul
description: A mod that overhauls most biomes and adds some new features.
body: Biomehaul, as the name may suggest, is a mod that completely rewrites the foundation of your world. This mod updates almost every single biome, adds completely new plants and blocks, and even adds a new Paleontologist's Table for you to excavate possible fossils. This mod may not seem like a lot, but it will update your world drastically. Thank you for installing BIOMEHAUL!
